links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses to AC joint dislocation patient questions using six metrics
links.effect: Readability scores showed moderate difficulty, suitable for a high school-level audience.
links.quote: Readability scores revealed moderate difficulty levels, suitable for a high school-level audience.

links.outcome: Surgeon-graded accuracy of ChatGPT clinical answers on 5-point Likert scale, by question category
links.effect: Average score 4/5 (good quality with minor inaccuracies); treatment questions scored lower than rehabilitation (P = .025).
links.quote: Treatment-related questions scored lower compared to other categories, with a significant difference observed between treatment and rehabilitation (P = .025).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to common patient questions regarding acromioclavicular joint dislocations using expert ratings and readability metrics, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
